items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Charlie Cudelo was going to play tenor sax... That was the 1925 band... Paul had a lot of... bad luck in it.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about the Victor session, too. Do you remember any details of that?

Yes, I do. That Victor session, Victor people came out here and contacted Paul, and they liked the band. That was the 1925 band. It was here in New Orleans. Well, Paul had a lot of, I don't want to say a lot, but he had bad luck in it. Charlie Cudelo was going to play tenor sax, Santa and trombone, and Red Long and Leo Addy, and that particular day they were going to record, Santo and Rap had a little falling out. So Rap walked off the set, and Paul went through it anyhow, and he made Charlie get off the tenor…
The O.K.'s were made down here too, weren't they?
